title: OAuth login returns 500 after refresh token expires
body: When the access token expires and the refresh request fails, POST /auth/login returns HTTP 500 instead of redirecting the user to sign in again. Reproduced in staging and production.

title: Users can see another customer's invoice by changing the invoice ID
body: Logged-in customer A can request /api/invoices/184 even when invoice 184 belongs to customer B. The API returns the invoice instead of 403. This is reproducible in staging.

title: Add dark mode to the dashboard
body: Please add a dark theme to the web dashboard with a user preference toggle and persistence across sessions.

title: Document how to run the project with Node.js 20
body: The README does not explain the required Node version or the commands for local setup. Please add installation, start, and test instructions.

title: Database CPU jumps to 95% during report generation
body: Generating the monthly analytics report causes the PostgreSQL CPU to remain above 90% for several minutes. Queries appear to scan the entire transactions table.

title: Deployments should run smoke tests before production rollout
body: Our GitHub Actions workflow deploys immediately after build. Add a smoke-test stage and prevent production deployment when health checks fail.

title: AI assistant gives confident answers when context is missing
body: When the RAG retriever returns zero useful documents, the assistant still produces a confident answer. We should detect insufficient context and request clarification or escalate.

title: Can we switch the API from REST to GraphQL?
body: Would GraphQL simplify the frontend data fetching? I am not proposing an implementation yet; I want to understand the trade-offs for this project.

title: Upgrade GitHub Actions checkout and setup-node versions
body: The repository still uses older action versions in CI. Update the workflow dependencies and verify tests continue to pass.

title: Search field becomes unusable on mobile screens
body: At widths below 380px the search input overlaps the filter button, preventing users from typing. Seen on Chrome Android.

title: Rotate leaked staging API key immediately
body: A staging third-party API key was accidentally pasted into yesterday's CI logs. The logs are visible to repository collaborators. We need to revoke and rotate the key and inspect recent usage.

title: Add CSV export for monthly transactions
body: Finance users want to download the filtered monthly transaction table as a CSV file from the dashboard.

title: Sometimes the app feels slow
body: A few pages feel slower than before, but I do not have exact timings or steps to reproduce. It might happen more often after leaving the app open for a while.

title: Should we cache AI classification responses?
body: Would caching repeated classification requests reduce latency and cost? What risks would we have if issue content changes?

title: Production health endpoint exposes internal build metadata
body: GET /health currently returns the commit SHA, server hostname, environment name, and deployment timestamp publicly. Please review whether this information should be exposed.
